title: "Executioner" by The End Is Near is a relentless deathcore track that leaves no survivors
htmlContent: The End Is Near is shaking up the deathcore music scene with their new single, "Executioner." This track is an explosive introduction that blends the raw energy of early 2000s hardcore with the precise sound of modern deathcore. Their upcoming debut EP promises to be an intense musical experience. "Executioner" throws listeners into a whirlwind of powerful rhythms and sharp guitar riffs, each hitting hard. The band skillfully mixes raw energy with a sense of timing, making every moment feel wild and controlled. The drums hammer away like a heavy weight, the guitars create darkness, and the vocals deliver a fierce intensity that grabs your attention. https://open.spotify.com/track/1hIwB0mlGv87ipK10JISOh?si=Xl3PjCsWQfmRTb_B1bAKmA This kind of track gets people moving in the mosh pit. As the first glimpse of their upcoming EP, "Executioner" signifies that The End Is Near is set on forging their own path. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok
